_about: Hausa review pack (2 Nov 2026 build), pages 15 and 16: sample medicine labels made by the Magana team (CC BY 4.0, not real medicines). The offline phone reading's lines, and the words the server marked as possibly missing a special letter (review_pages.html). Brydl's review, 13 Nov 2026: the offline reader must mark what the server marks.

pages.title: Sample medicine label 1 (not a real medicine)
offline_lines: SAMFURI NE KAWAI: BA MAGANI NA GASKE BA
Maganin Misali 500 mg
Sha kwaya 2 sau 3 a rana.
A sha bayan cin abinci.
A hadiye shi duka da ruwa.
Kada a tauna shi ko a nika shi.
Kada ka sha fiye da kwaya 8 cikin sa'o'i 24.
A ajiye shi nesa da hannun yara.
A ajiye shi a wuri mai sanyi da bushewa.
Ranar lalacewa: 03/2028

Darasi na 4: Rabe-rabe
Aisha tana da lemu 12. Ta raba su daidai ga kawayenta 3.
Kowace kawa ta samu lemu 4.
Dalibai 24 ne a aji. Rabinsu 'yan mata ne.
Tambaya: 'yan mata nawa ne a ajin?
Dan karamin bangare na lemu daya shi ne 1/4.
Darasin Kimiyya: Yanayin Ruwa
Ruwa yana da yanayi 3: kankara, ruwa da tururi.
Ruwa yana tafasa a digiri 100 na Celsius.
Yana daskarewa ya zama kankara a digiri 0.
Idan rana ta yi karfi, ruwa yana kafewa ya zama tururi.
Tururi yana tashi sama ya zama gajimare, sannan ruwan sama
ya sauka.
Sanarwar Makaranta
Za a yi taron iyaye a ranar Alhamis, 12 ga Nuwamba, 2026, da
karfe 10 na safe.
Dalibai su zo da littattafansu da kudin abinci N500.
Kowane dalibi ya kawo takardar izini daga iyayensa.
A kiyaye lokaci, don Allah.
Labari: Dan Tsuntsu
Wata karamar yarinya ta ga đan tsuntsu a karkashin bishiya.
Kafarsa ta karye, kuma yana jin kishirwa.
Ta dauke shi ta kai gida, ta ba shi ruwa da dan hatsi.
Yan'uwanta biyu suka taimaka mata.
Bayan kwana 7, đan tsuntsu ya warke ya tashi sama.
